001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BeamAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BeamEffectPlugin;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEntityAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamageType;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
013
014public class IonBeamEffect implements BeamEffectPlugin {
015
016        public static float ARC_DAMAGE_MULT_NORMAL = 1f;
017        public static float ARC_DAMAGE_MULT_PIERCED = 1f;
018        
019        private IntervalUtil fireInterval = new IntervalUtil(0.25f, 1.75f);
020        private boolean wasZero = true;
021        
022        
023        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, BeamAPI beam) {
024                CombatEntityAPI target = beam.getDamageTarget();
025                if (target instanceof ShipAPI && beam.getBrightness() >= 1f) {
026                        float dur = beam.getDamage().getDpsDuration();
027                        // needed because when the ship is in fast-time, dpsDuration will not be reset every frame as it should be
028                        if (!wasZero) dur = 0;
029                        wasZero = beam.getDamage().getDpsDuration() <= 0;
030                        //dur *= 2f;
031                        fireInterval.advance(dur);
032                        
033                        if (fireInterval.intervalElapsed()) {
034                                ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) target;
035                                boolean hitShield = target.getShield() != null && target.getShield().isWithinArc(beam.getRayEndPrevFrame());
036                                float pierceChance = ((ShipAPI)target).getHardFluxLevel() - 0.1f;
037                                pierceChance *= ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.SHIELD_PIERCED_MULT);
038                                
039                                boolean piercedShield = hitShield && (float) Math.random() < pierceChance;
040                                //piercedShield = true;
041                                
042                                if (!hitShield || piercedShield) {
043                                        Vector2f point = beam.getRayEndPrevFrame();
044                                        float mult = ARC_DAMAGE_MULT_NORMAL;
045                                        if (hitShield) {
046                                                mult = ARC_DAMAGE_MULT_PIERCED;
047                                        }
048                                        float emp = beam.getDamage().getFluxComponent() * mult;
049                                        float dam = beam.getDamage().getDamage() * mult;
050                                        engine.spawnEmpArcPierceShields(
051                                                                           beam.getSource(), point, beam.getDamageTarget(), beam.getDamageTarget(),
052                                                                           DamageType.ENERGY, 
053                                                                           dam, // damage
054                                                                           emp, // emp 
055                                                                           100000f, // max range 
056                                                                           "tachyon_lance_emp_impact",
057                                                                           beam.getWidth() + 9f,
058                                                                           beam.getFringeColor(),
059                                                                           beam.getCoreColor()
060                                                                           );
061                                }
062                        }
063                }
064//                      Global.getSoundPlayer().playLoop("system_emp_emitter_loop", 
065//                                                                                       beam.getDamageTarget(), 1.5f, beam.getBrightness() * 0.5f,
066//                                                                                       beam.getTo(), new Vector2f());
067        }
068}
